custom_headers.enabled_trusted_branch: Ol clears previously recognized matching headers, then preserves all parsed Is(name) custom values under supplied names. It returns before auto-header debug logging. Hy/By already ran before this choice.
custom_headers.enabled_generated_branch: Ol clears recognized matching names from base headers, tw clears alternate case/hashed matching names from custom text, then sets canonical generated header and logs generated header once.
custom_headers.disabled_branch: If em returns undefined, Ol returns {} without removing custom matching values. A send-time canonical-only filter does not automatically cover hashed aliases or custom headers.
custom_headers.risk: Treat user-specified matching headers as an independent explicit-input boundary; do not silently assume all SDK posture-header values were generated by Hy.

git_collection.normalization: Reads origin pushurl first then url from repo config, parses SSH/SCP or HTTP(S) URL, removes credentials and terminal .git, lowercases host/path; special CCR Git proxy normalization exists. By drops query/fragment and non-printable ASCII, slices to 126 characters.
git_collection.cache: Lut -> qn -> LBe(Pp().remoteSlugByRoot, root, ds). A wrapper that returns null before calling Lut does not replace or poison this shared memo. Earlier ur/$s root/canonical-root discovery still runs in By.
git_collection.facade: chunk-f4zhphs7.js reexports Lut as findRepoRemoteSlug. Exact symbol appears nowhere else in the parsed corpus. Observed dynamic import users destructure other Git operations; arbitrary computed namespace access is not disproved.
git_collection.scope_caution: Only one Lut call syntax exists in dj5rhvvh, inside By. No direct GX/IT call is observed in the eU factory. This is not a proof that an arbitrary callback/async descendant can never execute another shared Lut consumer under a broad eU ALS scope.
